## Literal recipe and limitations

Each selected profile produces13 new4096-byte records and4 retained4096-byte references,17files/69632B. New records are9 CURRENT variants plus XWE2(epoch2/3) and XWS2(epoch2/3). CURRENT variants are BaseOnly B/A, BaseOnly A/A, new BaseOnly/GenesisWalSealed fallback, new BaseOnly/old BaseWalSealed fallback, selected intent, burned-issued-with-no-intent representation, paired WalOpen, exact same-slot WalSealed, and empty-suffix WalSealed. All fields not specified by wire §6 are zero; trailer at4064 is SHA256 of bytes0..4064. Profile digest is the entire old4096-byte independent PROFILE SHA.

Base generation2/L7 digest is `SHA256(UTF8("XADB-G6-control-base-generation-2-lsn-7"))`; analogous tags cover generation1/L7 and generation3/L12. Sealed prefix digests use the documented `XADB-G6-control-` tag labels in generator.py. These are opaque local codec values. They do not purport to be a real XRB1 full-file SHA, a validated WAL prefix, a source closure, or evidence that deletion/epoch burn/recovery occurred. Genesis anchor/header/WRITER references use actual retained independent full-record SHA. No base/body/stream is synthesized to manufacture a recovery capability.

XWE2 fixes base generation2/L7, replay4096, max frame1048576, file cap268435456, predecessor epoch1 and predecessor completeLSN7. Its predecessor digest is an opaque local input. XWS2 generation equals epoch2/3 and binds that independently constructed XWE2 full SHA; active CURRENT generation is6/9. The intent binds epoch2, base2/L7, active6, and the independent XWE2/XWS2 SHA. No hash cycle is introduced. The burned CURRENT retains issued2 and writer high-water2 after clearing intent. This checks the representation, not the actual persist→recover→burn→e+1 transition.

## Concrete negative boundaries

N33 onward specifically separates equal physical snapshot slots from equal continuation: WalOpen previous BaseOnly, different epoch/base generation/baseL/baseSHA/headerSHA/WRITERSHA/writer generation all fail. A WalSealed pair must be exactly equal, including slot. BaseOnly/old sealed requires exact new captureL=old sealedLSN. Intent cannot coexist with WalOpen/WalSealed, must match issued epoch/base values, and must name checked current-generation+1; overflow is rejected. Absence of intent does not reset issued/floor/high-water fields. The metadata lists actual raw offsets and expected error variants for every mandatory negative.

Epoch and closure limits include a below-replay seal, seal beyond256MiB, sealedLSN belowbase, empty byte suffix with advancedLSN, nonempty suffix with unchangedLSN, max-frame/header-cap mismatches, source epoch0/equal-new-epoch and writer/base/active generation zero. Decoder input bytes remain unchanged. V01–05 exercise the public encoder entry's validation-before-write guarantee with all4096 output bytes still0xA5.

Actual two-slot publication, ACK-preserving fallback, burn of the exact persisted intent, no admission before both WalOpen selections, old-WAL-free reopen, directory census and reclaim authority remain separate future owner/native tests. In particular a local Current decode cannot establish monotonic high-water relative to an earlier selected record, prove a digest names an existing file, reject a third unknown epoch file, or certify the last complete frame boundary. It must not be used as that evidence.
